title: What's New: Create Multiple Fixed Assets (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Demo setup - creating first fixed asset and purchase order
Adding number of fixed assets cards field
Call to action and closing remarks

features.name: Create multiple fixed assets from purchase order
features.description: Ability to purchase multiple identical fixed assets at once by specifying quantity and number of fixed asset cards, which automatically creates individual asset records with sequential numbering.
caveats: Requires adding 'number of fixed assets cards' field via page personalization before posting
Quantity and number of fixed assets cards must be equal for automatic creation

features.name: Fixed asset global availability
features.description: The multiple fixed assets creation feature is now globally available to all databases instead of being limited to Italian localization.

features.name: Automatic asset numbering with number series
features.description: System automatically generates sequential fixed asset numbers using configured number series when creating multiple assets, incrementing by 10 (e.g., 100, 110, 120, 130).

quotes.text: previously this feature was part of Italian localization and now this is available to all databases and no localization globally
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that this capability has moved from regional localization to global availability, indicating significant scope expansion.

quotes.text: this is really important so you can automate asset creation never mind how many of them
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the core value proposition of unlimited bulk asset creation automation regardless of quantity.

quotes.text: Imagine you want to purchase 25 smartphones. So all of them are expensive. So they are fixed assets.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets up the practical use case and demonstrates the scenario the feature addresses.

quotes.text: I will enter 25 pieces as a quantity. But now if you click post nothing will happen.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that quantity alone is insufficient - additional configuration is needed for the automation to work.
